title: Driver Risk Standard: Quality Warnings and the Earnings Guarantee Scale
content:
## Criterion

The locked guarantee of a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings guarantee opt-in carries a quality scale. The quality scale follows the quality warnings recorded on the driver's standing record, the standing record of the driver's agreement under **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing**, within the last 6 whole months: 2 or more warnings scale the guarantee by 0.85; at least one but fewer than 2 warnings scale it by 0.93; no warning leaves it unscaled.

The quality scale multiplies the guaranteed amount stated on the offer, acting together with every other multiplier of that stated amount; amounts added to a locked guarantee come after that multiplication, and the locked guarantee is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Count of quality warnings in the last 6 whole months

| Quality warnings | Quality scale |
|---|---|
| 0 | Unscaled (1) |
| 1 | 0.93 |
| 2 | 0.85 |
| 3 or more | 0.85 |

Only entries recorded as quality warnings count. Safety reports, document entries, rating reviews and background rechecks on the standing record are not quality warnings. A warning recorded earlier than the last 6 whole months does not count.

## Hypothetical figures

A stated guaranteed amount of 200.00:

- with no quality warning in the 6 months: 200.00, unscaled;
- with 1 quality warning: 186.00 (200.00 multiplied by 0.93);
- with 2 quality warnings: 170.00 (200.00 multiplied by 0.85).
